summary: Grove Collaborative Holdings, Inc. filed an 8-K on May 7, 2026, reporting quarterly earnings, an investor presentation, and a general regulatory disclosure update under Items 2.02, 7.01, and 8.01. The filing is a routine earnings release and investor relations communication, not a special situation. No terms such as price per share, premium, or deal structure are provided. The company issued a press release for the quarter ended March 31, 2026, and posted a presentation on its website. There is no mention of any transaction, activist campaign, restructuring, or other event that qualifies as a special situation. The filing is an ordinary current report with no deal mechanics, advisors, or strategic change.
